description.value: Functional MRI study comparing high-functioning adults with autistic disorder and controls during explicit and implicit processing of emotional facial expressions.

spans.text: We used functional MRI to investigate brain activity in nine adults with autistic disorder (mean age ± standard deviation 37 ± 7 years; IQ 102 ± 15) and nine controls (27 ± 7 years; IQ 116 ± 10) when explicitly (consciously) and implicitly (unconsciously) processing emotional facial expressions.

description.value: Observational, cross-sectional comparison of autistic adults and healthy controls; experiment order was counterbalanced and participants gave informed consent.
